_about: Prices the Profitability agent uses, in QAR per kg. 'farmgate' is what a grower receives; 'retail' is the shop price. Confidence: official (Qatar Open Data), estimate (third-party modelled data), proxy (borrowed from a similar crop or the vegetable average), farmer (entered by you - the most trusted for your farm). Replace any row with your own buyer's price and set confidence to 'farmer'. USD converted at the fixed 3.64 QAR/USD peg.

vegetable_average_farmgate.source: Qatar Open Data: value of vegetable production / quantity (302.4 M QR / 112,800 t)

purple_amaranth.source: No Qatar price series for amaranth. Priced like spinach (farm-gate estimate). Enter your buyer's price.

lettuce.source: Selina Wamucii Qatar farm-gate estimate, USD 0.96/kg

spinach.source: Selina Wamucii Qatar farm-gate estimate, USD 0.99/kg. Imported packaged spinach retails far higher (QAR 9.50 per 125 g, 2026 supermarket listing).

parsley.source: Qatar Open Data consumer prices: Parsley / Qatar, QAR 4.50 per 200 g. Farm-gate not published; 2026 supermarket bunch price QAR 5.75.

tomato.source: Retail: Qatar Open Data, Tomato / Qatar QAR 3.00/kg. Farm-gate: Selina Wamucii estimate USD 0.55/kg.

cucumber.source: Retail: Qatar Open Data 2017 (Cucumber / Saudi Arabia). Farm-gate: Selina Wamucii estimate USD 0.77/kg.

_retail_share_note: When only a retail price exists, the grower is assumed to receive 45% of it. This is an assumption, so replace it with your own figure.
